demo.title: agent-data-tools.sh
demo.code:
# Ask which tool does a job (free)
curl "https://agent-data-tools.revmesh2074.workers.dev/find?need=token+price+on+base"

# Try a tool free (25 free successful calls per caller)
curl "https://agent-data-tools.revmesh2074.workers.dev/price/token?symbol=ETH&trial=1"

# Without a free call the answer is HTTP 402 with x402 terms (USDC on Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana)
curl -i "https://agent-data-tools.revmesh2074.workers.dev/check/counterparty?address=0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006"

# Calling often: prepay once with x402 and use the returned key on later calls
#   GET https://agent-data-tools.revmesh2074.workers.dev/credits/usdc/5  ->  { apiKey: "adt_..." }
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer adt_..." "https://agent-data-tools.revmesh2074.workers.dev/wallet/portfolio?address=0x..."

setup: No signup or API key: every caller gets 25 free successful calls (add trial=1)
Pay per call with any x402 client: USDC on Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana; most tools cost $0.01, everyday lookups $0.002; failed calls are never charged
Or prepay once: GET /credits/usdc/5 with x402 returns an API key worth 5,000 credits for later calls
